mapper.insert: INSERT INTO digital_team_tenant (business_id, name, description, owner_user_id, status, created_by) VALUES (#{businessId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{ownerUserId}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE digital_team_tenant SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{tenantId}
UPDATE digital_team_tenant SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE business_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, business_id, name, description, owner_user_id, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM digital_team_tenant ORDER BY created_at, business_id
